import json,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify as V
from protocol import validate, loads
def run(req):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()[:900]
    out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    V.verify(req,out,validate)
    return out['cases'][0]['events']
base=dict(nodes=2,edges=[[0,1,10]],commodities=[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':6,'paths':[[0]]}],
          workers=[[0]],quorum=1,max_lag=3,relax=[3,2],rho=2,mode='route')
# issue, save, deliver, restore  -> acceptance must roll back, ticket becomes obsolete
out=run({'cases':[dict(base,events=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'save','name':0},
   {'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},{'op':'restore','name':0},{'op':'audit'},
   {'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}])]})

assert out[4]['generation']==1

assert a['z']==[0.0] and a['dual']==[0.0], a
